id.description: journal id (journals/<id>.json) when the item is a journal of a release with the journals module
id.title: Id

distance.description: Jensen–Shannon distance to the reference years; null = too few
distance.title: Distance

active.description: published in the recent window R
active.title: Active

completeness.description: D2 metadata completeness 0–100 (not the official TCI assessment)
completeness.title: Completeness

group.description: map group holding most of its window articles
group.title: Group

low_data.description: fewer than min_articles in the window: every rate is null
low_data.title: Low Data

owner.description: owner institution as written (registry) or its most frequent written name
owner.title: Owner

owner_matched.description: the owner was found among the authors' organisations
owner_matched.title: Owner Matched

path.description: OJS path — shown when the registry gives no name
path.title: Path

inhouse_flag_share.description: journals.inhouse_flag_share: only journals whose owner_source is 'registry' may be marked above it; null = no mark
inhouse_flag_share.title: Inhouse Flag Share

keywords.description: topics named from author keywords (provider off or LLM fallback)
keywords.title: Keywords

llm.description: topics named by the LLM (incl. cached names)
llm.title: Llm

overrides.description: topics whose name an editor corrected (labeling.overrides_path)
overrides.title: Overrides

reused.description: topics that kept the previous release's name (lineage continue, keywords unchanged by labeling.reuse_min_jaccard) — no LLM call
reused.title: Reused

cost_usd.description: spend of this task for the whole release: every run, from the LLM journal
cost_usd.title: Cost Usd

this_run_cost_usd.description: spend of the run that produced this export
this_run_cost_usd.title: This Run Cost Usd

ci_level.description: level of every *_lo/*_hi interval in this release
ci_level.title: Ci Level

ingest_errors.description: files that could not be read or parsed; null = not recorded (work_dir from before per-file error recording)
ingest_errors.title: Ingest Errors

topic.description: a topic that kept its id through a merge or a split
topic.title: Topic

merged_into.description: the topic of this release it merged into (lineage); null = it ended
merged_into.title: Merged Into

no_baseline.description: no articles in the baseline window — show 'new — no baseline'
no_baseline.title: No Baseline
